T:P1.2.text: COMPLETE MULTISTAGE SOLUTIONS. FROM TOE TO HEEL.

T:P1.3.text: A broader completion portfolio designed to help operators improve execution, increase reliability, and maximize performance throughout the completion program.

T:P1.4.text: Take control of your downhole environment—stabilize the wellbore, prevent hazards, and push performance further with Managed Pressure Wells.

T:P1.5.text: Elevate your production strategy—revive output, extend reservoir life, and maximize recovery with precision-engineered Production and Intervention Solutions.

T:P1.6.text: From field to strategy, connect physical operations with digital execution. Industrial Intelligence is built to scale enterprise-wide and designed for every user.

T:P1.7.text: Lead the energy transition—cut emissions, boost efficiency, and deliver lasting value with breakthrough New Energy Solutions.

T:P1.21.text: We're proud to share the milestones that shaped our year—financially and operationally. From breakthrough innovations to strengthened partnerships, our focus remains on creating long-term value for all stakeholders. Explore how we’re delivering results, driving innovation, and building a more sustainable future.

T:P1.22.text: Producing energy for today and tomorrow.

T:P1.23.text: We lead innovative energy services by blending proven technologies with modern digitalization. Collaborating with world-class experts, we help customers optimize resources and unlock the full potential of their assets. Our strategic solutions enhance efficiency, flexibility, and responsibility across energy operations.

T:P1.24.text: We take pride in our global presence and commitment to innovation. By leveraging expertise, embracing technology, and fostering partnerships, Weatherford drives sustainable progress to meet customer needs and promote responsible practices for a better future.

T:P1.25.text: Join Us in Transforming an Industry

T:P1.26.text: We offer global opportunities as unlimited as your sense of adventure. Join us to make an impact on our customers, the industry, and the world.

T:P2.2.text: As a global leader in energy services, operators trust Weatherford to drive maximum value, streamline operations, and enhance safety. In partnership with our customers, we are committed to producing innovative energy solutions that are environmentally and economically sustainable to drive our industry forward.

T:P2.3.text: Individually, we are impressive. Together, we are unstoppable. We are One Weatherford. We seek out and value the unique perspectives of our world-class team and are committed to fostering a collaborative culture where everyone can grow and contribute.
